## About
Prestige Collision Center LLC is a body shop on Kennedale Parkway in Kennedale. We fix collision damage, dents, hail damage and paint, and we can help with your insurance claim along the way.
We want your visit to be friendly, easy and stress-free. That means a careful estimate, clear updates and attention to detail on every car that comes through our doors.
Our customers rate us 5 on Google from 29 reviews. Reviewers mention Bruno and Mr. Cruz by name for keeping them in the loop and making the whole thing smooth.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Repairing or replacing damaged parts and bringing your vehicle back to pre-accident condition.
- Hail Damage Repair: One reviewer brought in an SUV with hail damage and called the bodywork flawless.
- Paintless Dent Repair: Door dings, dents and hail damage worked out without disturbing your original paint.
- Dent Repair & Removal: Dents restored using both traditional and advanced methods.
- Fender Repair / Bumper Repair: One customer thought he needed a new bumper. We fixed it and it looks like nothing happened.
- Auto Paint Repair: Paint and refinish work treated as a craft.
- Paint Scratch Repair: Scratches cleaned up and blended back into the finish.
- Color Match: Matching your vehicle's factory finish so the repair disappears.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. Call or stop by with your questions or your claim. One reviewer said Bruno handled the insurance process for him.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Come by the shop on Kennedale Parkway for a personal estimate, or call or email us first.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
